mapper.select: SELECT repayment_id, plan_id, term, principal, interest, repayment_amount, due_date, repayment_status, repayment_time FROM monthly_repayment WHERE repayment_id = #{repaymentId}

SELECT mr.repayment_id, mr.plan_id, mr.term, -- 期数 mr.principal, -- 当期本金 mr.interest, -- 当期利息 mr.repayment_amount, -- 当期总还款额 mr.due_date, -- 到期还款日 mr.repayment_status, -- 还款状态 mr.repayment_time, -- 实际还款时间 rp.application_id, -- 关联的贷款申请ID rp.user_id -- 关联的用户ID（可选） FROM monthly_repayment mr -- 关联还款计划主表，获取更多上下文信息（如申请ID、用户ID） LEFT JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id -- 筛选条件：指定还款计划ID WHERE mr.plan_id = #{planId} -- 按期数升序排列（从第1期到最后一期） ORDER BY mr.term ASC
SELECT repayment_id, plan_id, term, principal, interest, repayment_amount, due_date, repayment_status, repayment_time FROM monthly_repayment WHERE repayment_status = #{status}

SELECT DISTINCT mr.repayment_id, mr.plan_id, mr.term, mr.principal, mr.interest, mr.repayment_amount, mr.due_date, mr.repayment_status, mr.repayment_time FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} AND mr.repayment_status = 'overdue'
SELECT mr.term AS term, COUNT(1) AS count FROM monthly_repayment mr WHERE mr.repayment_status = 'overdue' GROUP BY mr.term ORDER BY mr.term ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(mr.repayment_id) AS overdueCount FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE mr.repayment_status = 'overdue'
AND mr.due_date >= #{startDate}
AND mr.due_date <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(mr.repayment_id) AS count FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE mr.repayment_status = 'overdue'
AND mr.due_date >= #{startDate}
AND mr.due_date <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(mr.repayment_id) AS count FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE mr.repayment_status IN ('unpaid', 'overdue', 'paid')
AND mr.due_date >= #{startDate}
AND mr.due_date <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN sub.overdueAmount < 10000 THEN '1万以下' WHEN sub.overdueAmount < 30000 THEN '1-3万' WHEN sub.overdueAmount < 50000 THEN '3-5万' ELSE '5万以上' END AS `range`, SUM(sub.overdueAmount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT rp.user_id, SUM(mr.repayment_amount) AS overdueAmount FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE mr.repayment_status = 'overdue'
AND mr.due_date >= #{startDate}
AND mr.due_date <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY rp.user_id ) sub GROUP BY `range` ORDER BY MIN(sub.overdueAmount) ASC

SELECT mr.repayment_id AS repaymentId, rp.application_id AS applicationId, COALESCE(lp.product_name, '未知产品') AS productName, mr.term, DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate, mr.repayment_amount AS repaymentAmount, mr.principal, mr.interest, CASE mr.repayment_status WHEN 'unpaid' THEN 'pending' WHEN 'overdue' THEN 'overdue' END AS status, CASE mr.repayment_status WHEN 'unpaid' THEN '待还款' WHEN 'overdue' THEN '逾期' END AS statusDesc, CASE mr.repayment_status WHEN 'overdue' THEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), mr.due_date) ELSE 0 END AS overdueDays, 0 AS overduePenalty FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id LEFT JOIN loan_application la ON rp.application_id = la.application_id LEFT JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} AND mr.repayment_status IN ('unpaid', 'overdue') AND mr.due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY mr.repayment_status = 'unpaid' ASC, CASE WHEN mr.repayment_status = 'overdue' THEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), mr.due_date) ELSE 0 END DESC, mr.due_date ASC

SELECT mr.repayment_id AS repaymentId, mr.plan_id AS planId, mr.term, mr.repayment_amount AS repaymentAmount, mr.due_date AS dueDate, rp.user_id AS userId FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE mr.repayment_status = 'unpaid' AND mr.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{withinDays} DAY) ORDER BY mr.due_date ASC

SELECT mr.repayment_id AS repaymentId, rp.application_id AS loanId, mr.term AS period, mr.repayment_amount AS amount, DATE_FORMAT(mr.due_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate, DATE_FORMAT(mr.repayment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS repayDate, mr.repayment_status AS status FROM monthly_repayment mr INNER JOIN repayment_plan rp ON mr.plan_id = rp.plan_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY mr.due_date DESC
